name: gizza-ai/parse-datetime
summary: Parse a date/time string in many formats into structured components.

tool.description: Parse a single date and/or time string in many common formats (ISO 8601 / RFC 3339, RFC 2822 email, US slash, European dotted, year-first, month-name, and bare clock times) and return its structured components as JSON: kind, year, month (+ name), day, weekday, day_of_year, iso_week, hour/minute/second, utc_offset_seconds, and a canonical iso8601 rendering.

input.description: The date and/or time string to parse.
